This alone pushed your prediction firmly in the direction of failing. Your academic standing, however, worked in your favor. Both of these factors pulled the prediction toward passing, meaning your grades showed real promise. Unfortunately, the part-time enrollment had a greater impact than these two positive indicators combined, so the overall model still leaned toward failure. What should you do next? If you are able, attending full-time would directly address the strongest risk factor and likely change the prediction dramatically. You might also consider discussing your situation with the admissions office to see if they would reconsider with a full-time commitment, or ask whether your first-year and third-year performance could be weighed differently if you reapply. Strengthening an application for a future cycle should focus on aligning your study format with the pattern that leads to bar exam success.
